findings.title: A hard link under docs/dev/tmp lets verify --log overwrite a tracked store file and still record green
A red gate reaches the reviewers as a green Tests: N passed, 0 failed line
cap-check reads a rework regression as not a regression when the File cell names two paths or uses a common line shape
cap-check run from a subdirectory reports every row as not a regression and exits 0
cap-check trusts the head_sha frontmatter: a stale, reversed or branch-name value turns a stall into a deferral
A stray backtick or an emoticon pair excuses a whole phase order from the delegation guard
A negation joined by and cancels the order that follows it
A severity-emoji row behind an unlisted bullet, heading, checkbox or invisible lead passes the decision gate with no task
PRD names holding U+0085 or U+2028 still forge a Read next section in the session brief
A SIGHUP to verify orphans the gate, which keeps the gate lock until it finishes
Killing the replay's caller leaks the pytest runner, a registered worktree and its temp dir
PRD 00313 closed as done while the gate takes 293 s against its under-240 s line, and its CHANGELOG time was never written
Two user-visible changes ship with no CHANGELOG entry

findings.downgraded: claimed verified; that dev/bin/release proceeds was read from release:11, not executed (the lane may not run it); only the rg input check ran
findings.title: CRITICAL hold stubs do not block a release
A gate that ran and then dirtied the tree is reported as gate skipped, hiding a red result
statectl.py get --default cannot be found, and some argument orders give a silent wrong answer or a crash
The markers error tells the user to pass --state, which the verb rejects
markers --clear follows the physical cwd past a nested repo's root and can clear another store's park or pause request
HEAD's findings sweep refuses a real review for a prose [4/4], with an error pointing at a missed findings row
The guard costs 0.77 s/MB on dense SKILL.md mentions and reaches the 5 s hook timeout at about 6.3 MB
cap-check starts one to two git processes per row and repeats work per file
Lock wait and gate run share one deadline, so a late waiter's gate is killed and reported as a suite timeout
A heavily rewritten rename makes unchanged lines read as regressions
The CHANGELOG says verify takes its exit from the summary line; it also uses the process exit
The skip ceiling cannot see shell-harness skips
One of the three tolerated skips can never run, and nothing says where it would
recovery.md tells the operator to resume cap_regression like cap_critical, but no custody exists for it
The 0.10 release step (run the live MCP test by hand) is written only in audit notes
The delegation guard crashes on the system Python 3.9
